parent.title: [{{date}}] Weekly GEO Authority
description: New pipeline owned by GEO Specialist. Establishes the AI-visibility flywheel: track brand mentions, test AI citation, improve article citability, maintain llms.txt.
5. Step 5 → unblock step 6 (execute) for Content Manager.

As orchestrator (you, **@GEO Specialist**), you receive @mentions when each cross-agent step finishes. **Wake immediately on mention** — verify the step output, then transition the NEXT blocked task from `blocked` → `todo` and @mention the next executor.
This is what keeps the pipeline moving fast. Without it, each handoff costs up to 2h waiting for the next executor's scheduled heartbeat.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] GEO Authority — Read history
description: ## Pull GEO learning from prior weeks
node scripts/tools/pipeline-memory.mjs recall weekly-geo-authority 'brand mentions, AI citations, citability changes, llms.txt updates, platform-specific findings' --limit 10 --days 90

**If recall exits non-zero**: do NOT block the pipeline. Instead, post a warning comment ('Memory recall failed: <error>. Proceeding without historical context for this run.') and continue with the rest of the steps using only current data. Only block the pipeline if the WRITE step (last task) fails — that's where we'd lose this run's learning forever. Exit codes: 3 = Ollama unavailable (most common, transient), 2 = network/auth (catastrophic, escalate to Founding Engineer).

**Coordination check**: if Weekly Search Strategy ran today (Mon 09:00, scheduled before this), look for memory tagged `pipeline:weekly-search-strategy run:<current-week>`. Read its `geo-analysis` findings to avoid double-analyzing the same data.
If recall succeeds, post the output and identify:
- Last Brand Authority Score baseline (target this week)
- Last week's memory ID (you'll update its outcome in step 7)
- Articles already restructured for citability (don't repeat unless 4+ weeks passed)
- AI platforms where we trended up/down
If baseline run: state 'BASELINE — establishing first GEO data point'.
Set task to done. (Even with degraded recall, this step's job is to surface what history we have — empty is OK.)

tasks.title: [{{date}}] GEO Authority — AI citation test
description: ## Test if AI systems cite Superdots on representative queries
Pick 10-15 queries across our content categories (sales, marketing, HR, ops, finance, etc.). Format: 'best AI [tool] for [department] 2026'.
- ChatGPT (web-enabled if API allows; otherwise document approach)
- If yes: was it cited as source link, paraphrased, or just brand name?
- Which competitors WERE cited? (zapier blog, hubspot blog, hubspot.com, jasper.ai blog, clickup, notion, etc.)
AI Citation Rate this week: X% (X / Y queries cited Superdots)

tasks.title: [{{date}}] GEO Authority — Citability pass on top articles
description: ## Pick 3 high-impression articles and propose citability improvements
From this week's GSC data (top impressions / top positions ≤ 15), pick 3 articles where:
- We have impressions but low CTR (likely AI Overview suppression)
- Citability gaps are clear (no FAQ, no clear definitions, no comparison table)
- We haven't restructured in last 4 weeks
Invoke `geo-citability` for each. Score and identify exact passages to add/restructure.
2. Add FAQ section with N questions: <list>
4. Rewrite passage X for clearer citation: <quote>
Expected outcome: AI citation rate +X%, CTR delta +Y%

tasks.title: [{{date}}] GEO Authority — Refresh llms.txt
description: Invoke `geo-llmstxt`. It defines the format spec and curation criteria.
1. Read current /public/llms.txt (if exists) or determine baseline.
3. Curate: include the 30-40 highest-quality articles (top GSC impressions OR cornerstone pieces). Skip thin pages (legal, about pages, redirects).
5. Validate: no duplicates, no broken URLs, proper structure.
If llms.txt needs changes, write the new content to /tmp/llms.txt-{{date}} and post a diff vs current as comment. Mark whether the next step (execute) should open a PR for it.
If no changes needed: comment 'llms.txt current — no PR needed'.
2. Transition next task (execute) from `blocked` → `todo` and @mention **@Content Manager** to wake them.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] GEO Authority — Create action issues
description: ## Convert GEO findings into executable issues
Read all 4 prior task comments and create issues:
Body: copy the citability brief from [{{citability_pass.identifier}}] for that article. Include 'definitions, FAQ, comparison tables' instructions.
### 2-3 brand-seeding briefs (lightweight memos, not full issues)
If [{{brand_sweep.identifier}}] identified seeding opportunities, post a comment on this task with 'Seeding briefs for next week' — Luca will decide manually whether to act.
Comment with all created issue IDs.
2. @mention **@GEO Specialist** in a comment with a brief summary of your output, so they can verify and unblock the next step. Without this, they'll wait up to 2h for their next scheduled heartbeat.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] GEO Authority — Write history
description: ## Write GEO insights to memory for cross-week iteration
## Step 1 — Update last week's memory outcome
From [{{read_history.identifier}}] you have last week's memory ID. Based on this week's brand-sweep + citation-test results vs last week's predictions:
# 'good' if BAS / citation rate moved as predicted; 'neutral' mixed; 'negative' regressed
## Step 2 — Compose this week's memory entry
## Brand Authority Score: X/100 (Δ vs last week: Y)
## AI Citation Rate: X% across N queries
Per-platform: ChatGPT X%, Perplexity Y%, Bing Z%
- If we restructure articles X, Y, Z this week → expect AI Citation Rate to move from N% to M% in 2 weeks
Any shared assets touched / decisions to align on
node scripts/tools/pipeline-memory.mjs write weekly-geo-authority --content "$TMPFILE" --outcome pending --agent GEO_SPECIALIST --tag domain:geo
**If write exits 4** (NULL embedding — Ollama down): set task to `blocked`, notify on-call.
**If write exits 2 or 5**: investigate; set `blocked` if not resolvable.
**Only on exit 0**: set task and parent to done.
